records.title: Flutter semantic typography and text scaling
records.guidance: Use app text roles through ThemeData and inherit TextScaler; let labels wrap before truncating a primary action.
records.validation: Widget tests cover the largest supported text scale.

records.title: Flutter motion states
records.guidance: Use implicit animation for a single state change and an AnimationController for coordinated phases; remove travel and stagger for reduced motion.
records.validation: A reduced-motion path preserves resting content and actions.

records.title: Flutter compact through expanded layout
records.guidance: Use LayoutBuilder constraints and logical leading/trailing alignment; consume safe-area insets once.
records.validation: Golden or widget coverage includes compact and tablet constraints.

records.title: React Native list state and identity
records.guidance: Use native virtualization, stable keys, lightweight rows, and measured render changes.
records.validation: Representative list tests retain interaction state.

records.title: SwiftUI dynamic type and sheets
records.guidance: Use system text styles, size-class-aware layouts, NavigationStack, and native sheets.
records.validation: Simulator tests retain actions at accessibility text sizes.

records.title: Compose window sizes and semantics
records.guidance: Use Material3, window size classes, semantic modifiers, Insets, and scalable text units.
records.validation: Instrumentation and screenshot checks cover compact, medium, and expanded layouts.

records.title: Typed async visual states
records.guidance: Keep data access outside presentation components and provide typed loading, empty, error, retry, and populated states.
records.validation: UI tests render every state without a backend dependency.

records.title: Subject-specific hierarchy
records.guidance: Name the user job, hierarchy, and one signature interaction before applying visual polish.
records.validation: A critique can name a deliberate product-specific choice.
